sources.excerpt: Microtubes Vintage Deluxe Published on January 17, 2014 Darkglass Electronics boost / preamp pedal NAMM 2014 model 2014 model 2014 model 2014 preview model 2014 preview model 2014 preview model 2014 preview model 2016 model 2016 model 2016 model 2016 model 2016 model 2016 Information Darkglass Electronics The Vintage Deluxe features the warm, tube-like tones of the Microtubes Vintage and adds a 3-band active EQ, parallel output and balanced line driver. It delivers the natural dynamic response and organic compression of classic tube amps and tape machines, fitting four decades of legendary tones into a package that will fit in your gig bag. Controls Level: Sets the volume of the overdriven signal. Drive: Sets the amount of saturation in the overdriven signal. Blend: Mixes the clean input signal with the overdriven signal. The clean signal remains at unity gain while the volume of the overdriven signal is set by the Level knob, allowing for fine control of the blend ratio. Era: Interacts with the Drive knob to shape the character of the pedal. Dial it down to get the warm midrange tones of the '70s or crank it up to get the punchy metallic tones of '80s and '90s rock. Features: Bass: +-12dB @ 100Hz Mid: +-12dB @ 1kHz Treble: +-12dB @ 5kHz Parallel Output: A passthrough for your input signal, useful for parallel processing Direct Output: A balanced version of the ¼" output, useful for running into PA's or studio mixing consoles The Vintage Deluxe has a current draw of 30mA. Only use a regulated 9V DC adapter with a center-negative plug. Due to ecological reasons it does not accept batteries. Unregulated power supplies and/or higher voltages may result in suboptimal noise performance and even damage your unit, voiding the warranty.

(In Stock) - Darkglass Electronics Microtubes Vintage Deluxe V2 quantity + Add to cart SKU: XHE3432517951 Category: USED Share Description Reviews (0) The Darkglass Electronics Vintage Deluxe is a highly regarded bass preamp and overdrive pedal that combines the warmth of vintage tube amps with the precision and versatility needed by modern bassists. Known for its natural-sounding overdrive and robust EQ controls, its a go-to tool for players seeking rich, dynamic tones with ample control over their sound. Heres a closer look at the Vintage Deluxe and what makes it a staple for bassists worldwide: Key Features Vintage-Inspired Overdrive: True to its name, the Vintage Deluxe is crafted to emulate the rich, warm tones of classic tube amplifiers. Its drive section offers everything from subtle grit to thick, creamy saturation, preserving the basss natural character even at higher gain levels. Comprehensive EQ Section: The pedals four-band EQ includes Bass, Low Mid, High Mid, and Treble controls, allowing bassists to dial in the precise tonal balance they need. This flexibility makes it versatile enough for a range of genres, from rock to metal to jazz. Blend Control: The Blend knob lets players mix their clean and overdriven signals, preserving clarity and low-end punch while adding harmonic richness from the drive. This feature is essential for maintaining a solid foundation in the mix, especially in live settings. Parallel Outputs and Direct Out: The Vintage Deluxe includes both 1/4″ and XLR outputs, allowing it to function as a DI box in studio and live settings. The XLR output is equipped with a ground lift switch, making it ideal for going directly into a mixing console or PA system with minimal noise. Enhanced Low-End Response: The pedal is designed with bass frequencies in mind, ensuring that no low-end is sacrificed, even at higher drive settings. This makes it especially useful for bassists who rely on maintaining a full-bodied tone. High Build Quality: Built by Darkglass in Finland, the Vintage Deluxe is known for its rugged design, with a sturdy metal chassis and high-quality components that can withstand extensive touring and live performance use. Includes original box.
